scenario_definition.name: 3 omitted dimensions; intended use: University Student Residence (specific CDP/PNRR grant)
scenario_definition.initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an office building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Office-to-student-residence conversion and CDP/PNRR funding are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.
A university student residence needs schools and universities within easy reach. The value is set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the three extracted requirements. tipologia_bene_immobile is not in filterable_columns, so its value is applied to the canonical property_type column, which holds the same allowed value. energy_class is limited to A1-A4, B, and C. education >= 75 is applied directly. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC.
